_what: The kinds of places list an account keeps (src/place-lists.mjs). A places list is an ordinary list whose rows are places: each row names the installed implementation it runs on, who pays, the parts it keeps and the rule (`when`, an applies-when field over the kind's `facts`) that must hold for it to be chosen. Rows are tried in `order`, lowest first. The account's own rows are its own (it adds one when it connects a cloud or a device); the default rows come from the default publishers' published rows on the kind's shelf (src/marketplace-defaults.mjs), shown beside them through the published-defaults row source, and an own row with the same id is used instead of a default one. This file holds no place: only each kind's list definition, the facts its rules read and the parts a place keeps.
